footer.blurb: Excursions and day trips from Sharm El Sheikh — sea, desert and history. No prepayment, hotel transfer included.

cta.title: Ready to discover Egypt?
cta.text: Tell us your dates and what you love — we'll build the perfect trip for your group and budget. Reply in minutes, no prepayment.

faq.a: We run excursions from Sharm El Sheikh — Red Sea boat trips, desert safaris and day trips to Dahab, Cairo, Luxor and Petra. Hurghada, Cairo and Marsa Alam are coming soon.

faq.q: Do I have to pay in advance?
faq.a: For most excursions, no. Reserve your place in just a few minutes and pay on the day of your tour. Selected experiences such as flights, private tours and large groups may require a deposit.
Yes, return transfer from your hotel's main entrance is included in the price of every excursion.

Open any excursion, choose a date, your hotel and the number of guests, and send the booking request. You'll get a booking reference straight away and our team confirms everything with you on WhatsApp.
Yes — standard bookings can be cancelled free of charge more than 24 hours before the start. See our Terms & Conditions for the exceptions.
Message us on WhatsApp, use the contact form, or send us an email — we usually reply within minutes.

destSection.title: Choose where your adventure begins
destSection.text: From the coral reefs of the Red Sea to the pyramids of Giza — pick where your adventure begins.

01.name: Sharm El Sheikh
01.text: The Red Sea's crown — world-class diving, desert safaris, island cruises and Mount Moses.

02.name: Hurghada
02.text: Endless beaches, vibrant reefs and water sports along Egypt's mainland Red Sea coast.

03.name: Cairo
03.text: The Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx and the Grand Egyptian Museum — 5,000 years of history.

04.name: Marsa Alam
04.text: Untouched reefs, dolphin houses and pure, uncrowded diving in the deep south.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to {name}. These Terms & Conditions apply to all bookings, services and activities provided by {name}, a tour operator in Egypt. By confirming a booking, you agree to the following terms and policies.

confirmation.title: Booking confirmation
confirmation.text: Most of our excursions require no prepayment: reserve your place online or on WhatsApp and pay on the day of your activity. We will send your booking confirmation by email or WhatsApp.
confirmation.listIntro: The following bookings require a deposit or full payment in advance and are non-refundable (see 2.2):
confirmation.after: These reservations are confirmed once your payment has been successfully processed.

balance.title: Balance payment
balance.text: Where a deposit has been paid, the remaining balance must be paid in full at least 48 hours before the scheduled activity. Failure to complete payment by the deadline may result in your reservation being cancelled.

methods.title: Accepted payment methods
methods.request: Available on request — contact us for details
methods.note: Note: the 3.5% processing fee is non-refundable and applies to all refunds made via card or online payment.

standard.title: Standard cancellations
standard.intro: Except for the non-refundable bookings listed in 2.2:
standard.early: More than 24 hours before the start of the activity
standard.earlyResult: Full refund of the booking price
standard.late: 24 hours or less before the start, or no-show
